title: [Q-2] Add MetricKit crash and hang reporting

title: [A-5] Ask for notifications after the first save, or provisionally
description: Asked on screen 3 before any value (Onboarding.swift:112-124); never asked again after Not now (ON-6).

description: Inbox.swift:95 filters only From, Date, Subject, To; Outlook 'Sent: Monday' becomes a false event (GEN-1).

title: [D-2] Acknowledge mail only after a successful save
description: Inbox.swift:165-168 acks after try? save; a failed save loses mail for good (IOS-11).

title: [D-3] Fix share extension memory on large photos
description: Full decodes of up to 10 photos on main thread (ShareViewController.swift:81,112,147; Relay.swift:48-49). 48 MP is about 190 MB vs about 120 MB limit (IOS-3).

title: [P-6] Make App Store text and README match what is built
description: README.md:3-6 promises Lock Screen, Watch and Siri and says Midnight Gold was chosen. None built (SPEC 7). Guideline 2.3.

title: [P-7] Write review notes and a reviewer demo path
description: Reviewer needs a forwarding address path, a sample email to send, and the Apple Intelligence off behavior. See 05-release-checklist.md.

description: Repo is public. EmailPostTests.swift:6,20-21 and EmailCalendarTests.swift:25 name your children; fixture newsletter-27-dates.txt:27-31,44 carries real Wilmington details.

description: Decided Nov 2 (SPEC 8). 30-day TTL at relay:90-92 (PRIV-6). Needs F-1 so mail is collected without opening the app.

title: [A-3] Confirm a save from Keep something
description: AddSheet.swift:213-217 closes silently; share sheet says 'Kept. It comes back tomorrow.' (UX-2).

title: [R-6] Cut KV operations per mail and fix list paging
description: 7 deletes per ack (relay:777), list per poll, owner list stops at 1,000 keys (relay:744-745, RELAY-4).

title: [R-8] Harden /preview: manual redirects, 10 s timeout, refuse IP literals
description: relay:195 follows redirects without re-check; hostname-only private filter (RELAY-6).

title: [A-4] Show a resting gesture hint on the first few posts
description: Hints appear only mid-drag (TodayView.swift:267-283) (UX-4, H6 score 2).

description: Decided Nov 2: the record's only version is 1.0 (project.yml:15 says 2.0.0). Confirm App Store Connect accepts it on the next upload.

description: Auto import reads only Shoebox 1 files (Backups.swift:44-57,70-86); no NSUbiquitousContainers in App/Info.plist (IOS-6).

description: relay:755-763 mints with any 24-char key, no limit, no expiry (RELAY-1). Abuse can exhaust KV writes for everyone.

description: Suffix is 4 chars from 32 (relay:657-660), bounces reveal valid addresses (relay:85,90-92), no per-box quota (RELAY-3).

description: /me/delete is fire-and-forget and the key is cleared on the next line (SettingsView.swift:362-368); mailFor and backups remain; count includes soft-deleted (SettingsView.swift:9) (IOS-10, RELAY-9, UX-8).

description: Backups.swift:279,289-291 use try? with no NSFileCoordinator (IOS-7).

description: Onboarding.swift:73-107 asks for a first name on screen 2 (ON-5).

description: StockPhoto.swift:237,256; DateReader.swift:210-211 (AI-5, GEN-10, GEN-11).

title: [R-9] De-duplicate mail by Message-ID and ack only after attachments arrive
description: Id is timestamp plus random (relay:87); phone de-dup on subject window (Inbox.swift:79-82) (RELAY-10).

description: SPEC 7 item 1. Strongest return lever not yet built.

UK, Australia and NZ schools use Year 1 to 13 (EmailCalendar.swift:107-116). Use the device region for numeric order.

description: EmailCalendar.swift:97,107-116,135-139,196-201 (GEN-8, GEN-9).

description: testflight.yml:43,79 (QA-6).

description: TodayView.swift:94-97; OpenedView.swift:180-190 (AX-7, AX-14).

title: [UX-1] Text did not grow with Dynamic Type anywhere
description: UX audit run 1 (Nov 7): 122 Dynamic Type issues; the Accessibility XXXL run looked the same as the default. Every size was .font(.system(size:)). Fixed: ScaledFont (Shared/Surface.swift), capped at accessibility2.

title: [UX-2] The closed Shoebox sheet was in VoiceOver's reach on Today
description: UX audit run 1: on Today the whole Shoebox list (Today, Settings, every row) was in the accessibility tree at opacity 0; it also made Today slow enough that UI queries timed out. Hidden at the sheet, the list and Today's side. XCUITest still lists them (it reads SwiftUI's testing tree), so confirm with VoiceOver on a phone (08-ux-audit.md section 7).

title: [UX-3] Text fields had no accessibility label
description: UX audit run 1: Keep something new's words field (and Edit's Title, Words, Why, the share sheet's Why) read as unlabeled. Fixed: titles on the TextFields.

title: [UX-4] Undo covered the lower edge of the post's panel
description: UX audit run 1, J2 after flick up: the Undo pill sat over the panel. Fixed: over a post it sits at the top right under the count; on the end screen above + New.

title: [UX-5] Get my address had a short tap area
description: UX audit run 1, onboarding: hit region too small. Fixed: 44 pt label.

title: [UX-6] Quiet text near the contrast line
description: UX audit run 1: quiet words 'nearly passed' in light (5.4 to 1) and Stone light was 4.6 to 1. Raised: light 6.4, Plum dark 7.1, Stone light 5.6, Stone dark higher.

title: [UX-7] Today holds all six newsletter dates on the day it arrives (1 of 11)
description: UX audit: SPEC section 4 says dates more than a week out go to Coming up with one line on Today; the app shows them all. Graham's decision (SPEC wins).

title: [UX-8] Undo for a dated post says 'Back 5 days before' without the day
description: UX audit: say the day it comes back (Back Monday, Back Nov 9). Rules.swift next().

title: [UX-9] A dated post left in the pile could miss its own day
description: UX audit time replay, day 9: Picture day (never flicked on arrival) sat behind an older passed note; with a daily limit it could be left out on its day. Fixed: a dated post within 5 days of its day counts as coming back (TodayRules.pick), with a unit test.

title: [UX-10] Large text broke Settings words mid-word and overflowed the writing panel
description: UX audit big-text run: 'Automat ic', 'Backu ps', 'Lig ht'; the Why field clipped above the keyboard. Fixed: rows and choices stack when they do not fit; writing screens capped at xxxLarge.
